title: Ocean shells on the Eridu ziggurat summit
summary: Matt tells of Ocean shells on the Eridu ziggurat summit, about ancient flood era at Eridu, Iraq, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: eridu I was able to identify uh ocean shells that are still on the zigurat summit that would have been more inclined to have like a Persian Gulf flood from the ocean

plain: A researcher named Matt, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says that at Eridu, an ancient city in southern Iraq, he found ocean shells still lying on top of its ziggurat, a stepped temple tower. He says this fits a flood coming in from the sea, the Persian Gulf, rather than from rivers. He tells it as possible evidence of a great ancient flood.
